title: Localize Chat actions and Agent status in both app languages
goal: Ensure key Chat actions, automatic response-language selection, context setting, and Agent busy status render in the selected app language.
context: Source inspection found several Vietnamese UI literals used as localization keys without English mappings, and the recently added Settings Picker key `Context turns` was absent from both localization catalogs. This causes language switching to leave mixed-language labels.
forbidden_changes: Do not change Chat behavior, persistence, provider routing, or runtime execution.
Do not modify unrelated UI copy or redesign controls.
Do not claim physical-device verification from CI alone.
acceptance_criteria: Agent busy status uses a stable English localization key with English and Vietnamese translations.
Automatic, Regenerate answer, Export conversation, Share answer, and Context turns have entries in both localization catalogs.
Selected locale controls all touched labels without changing action behavior.
Task contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA gates pass.
verification: Confirm task-contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI gates.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if localization lookup or Chat action behavior regresses.
